root_cause.text: Missing reference count decrement for the `userq->last_fence` dma_fence object during queue teardown in `amdgpu_userq_fence_driver_free()`, causing the fence to remain allocated in the slab cache after driver unload.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `dma_fence_put(userq->last_fence);` to the `amdgpu_userq_fence_driver_free()` function. The CVE description explicitly states "This pointer holds an extra dma_fence reference" and "we forgot to drop the last_fence reference" and "Because of the missing dma_fence_put(), the last fence object can stay alive when the driver unloads." The kernel error message shows `BUG amdgpu_userq_fence: Objects remaining on __kmem_cache_shutdown()`, confirming that the fence object was not properly freed due to the missing reference count decrement.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix reference leak by explicitly releasing the last_fence object before destroying fence driver structures in usermode queue cleanup.
intent_record.what: Added two lines at the beginning of amdgpu_userq_fence_driver_free(): a call to dma_fence_put(userq->last_fence) and a blank line for spacing.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that the reference count of userq->last_fence is decremented before the function proceeds to walk and destroy fence driver structures. Without this explicit put, the fence object would not be properly released, causing a reference leak when the usermode queue is freed.
